	precondition:
		LoanTerm.allInstances()->forAll(lt: LoanTerm|lt.ItemID<>itemid)

		LoanTerm.allInstances()->exists(lt: LoanTerm|lt.oclIsNew() and
		lt.ItemID = itemid and
		lt.Content = content) and
		result = true
}
